title: Butterfly Lovers
synopsis: This is our elementary level adaptation of the classic Chinese legend “Butterfly Lovers”.

fullText.simplified:
他？她？（一）

    一千六百年前，杭州。
    周小英想去上学，但是她不能去上学。
    周小英的家有很多房子、很多地，她的家是杭州最有钱的人家。周家有周爸爸、周妈妈、周一一和周小英。
    周一一是哥哥，二十三岁，在百书学校读书。百书学校是那里最大、最好的学校。
    周小英是妹妹，十六岁。周爸爸和周妈妈都很喜欢这个女儿。女儿要什么，他们就给什么。
    小英看哥哥读书，她也想读书。但是那个时候，女孩子要在家里学习做衣服、做饭，不能上学。在学校里上学的都是男孩子，没有女孩子。
    周小英想去上学，但是她的爸爸妈妈不给她去上学。
    小英想：我要怎么办？她想了很长时间，想到了一个好办法。
    一天，周小英的下人小七跑来告诉周爸爸周妈妈：“小英小姐生病了！”
    周爸爸周妈妈来到小英的房间，看到小英睡在床上，看起来很累。他们找了医生来家里给小英看病，但是医生看来看去，没有看出小英得的是什么病。他们找了很多个医生，但是都没有医生知道小英得的是什么病。
    周爸爸和周妈妈就这么一个女儿，他们很爱这个女儿。他们想：要是有哪个医生能让我们的女儿好起来，医生说什么，我们就做什么。
    几天后，一个医生来到小英家。他不是很高，但是穿着很大的衣服，看起来很好笑。周爸爸和周妈妈看着这个医生，他们觉得这个医生好像在哪里见过。
    这个医生来到小英房间，给小英看病。他看了一会儿后，走出房间，对周爸爸周妈妈说：“我知道你们的女儿得的是什么病。”
    周爸爸和周妈妈很高兴，问：“我们的女儿得的是什么病？你快说。”
（未完待续）
fullText.traditional:
他？她？（一）

    一千六百年前，杭州。
    周小英想去上學，但是她不能去上學。
    周小英的家有很多房子、很多地，她的家是杭州最有錢的人家。周家有周爸爸、周媽媽、周一一和周小英。
    周一一是哥哥，二十三歲，在百書學校讀書。百書學校是那裡最大、最好的學校。
    周小英是妹妹，十六歲。周爸爸和周媽媽都很喜歡這個女兒。女兒要什麼，他們就給什麼。
    小英看哥哥讀書，她也想讀書。但是那個時候，女孩子要在家裡學習做衣服、做飯，不能上學。在學校裡上學的都是男孩子，沒有女孩子。
    周小英想去上學，但是她的爸爸媽媽不給她去上學。
    小英想：我要怎麼辦？她想了很長時間，想到了一個好辦法。
    一天，周小英的下人小七跑來告訴周爸爸周媽媽：“小英小姐生病了！”
    周爸爸周媽媽來到小英的房間，看到小英睡在床上，看起來很累。他們找了醫生來家裡給小英看病，但是醫生看來看去，沒有看出小英得的是什麼病。他們找了很多個醫生，但是都沒有醫生知道小英得的是什麼病。
    周爸爸和周媽媽就這麼一個女兒，他們很愛這個女兒。他們想：要是有哪個醫生能讓我們的女兒好起來，醫生說什麼，我們就做什麼。
    幾天後，一個醫生來到小英家。他不是很高，但是穿著很大的衣服，看起來很好笑。周爸爸和周媽媽看著這個醫生，他們覺得這個醫生好像在哪裏見過。
    這個醫生來到小英房間，給小英看病。他看了一會兒後，走出房間，對周爸爸周媽媽說：“我知道你們的女兒得的是什麼病。”
    周爸爸和周媽媽很高興，問：“我們的女兒得的是什麼病？你快說。”
（未完待續）

sentences.simplified: 一千六百年前，杭州。
sentences.traditional: 一千六百年前，杭州。
sentences.pinyin: yì qiān liù bǎi nián qián háng zhōu
sentences.english: 1,600 years ago, Hangzhou.

sentences.simplified: 周小英想去上学，但是她不能去上学。
sentences.traditional: 周小英想去上學，但是她不能去上學。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu xiǎo yīng xiǎng qù shàng xué dàn shì tā bù néng qù shàng xué
sentences.english: Zhou Xiao Ying wanted to go to school, but she couldn’t go to school.

sentences.simplified: 周小英的家有很多房子、很多地，她的家是杭州最有钱的人家。
sentences.traditional: 周小英的家有很多房子、很多地，她的家是杭州最有錢的人家。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu xiǎo yīng de jiā yǒu hěn duō fáng zi hěn duō dì tā de jiā shì háng zhōu zuì yǒu qián de rén jiā
sentences.english: Zhou Xiao Ying’s family had a lot of houses and a lot of land. Her family was the wealthiest family in Hangzhou.

sentences.simplified: 周家有周爸爸、周妈妈、周一一和周小英。
sentences.traditional: 周家有周爸爸、周媽媽、周一一和周小英。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu jiā yǒu zhōu bà ba zhōu mā ma zhōu yī yī hé zhōu xiǎo yīng
sentences.english: The Zhou family was Father Zhou, Mother Zhou, Zhou Yiyi and Zhou Xiao Ying.

sentences.simplified: 周一一是哥哥，二十三岁，在百书学校读书。
sentences.traditional: 周一一是哥哥，二十三歲，在百書學校讀書。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu yī yī shì gē ge èr shí sān suì zài bǎi shū xué xiào dú shū
sentences.english: Zhou Yiyi was the older brother, 23 years old, and studied at the School of a Hundred Books.

sentences.simplified: 百书学校是那里最大、最好的学校。
sentences.traditional: 百書學校是那裡最大、最好的學校。
sentences.pinyin: bǎi shū xué xiào shì nà lǐ zuì dà zuì hǎo de xué xiào
sentences.english: The School of a Hundred Books was the biggest and best school there.

sentences.simplified: 周小英是妹妹，十六岁。
sentences.traditional: 周小英是妹妹，十六歲。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu xiǎo yīng shì mèi mei shí liù suì
sentences.english: Zhou Xiao Ying was the younger sister, 16 years old.

sentences.simplified: 周爸爸和周妈妈都很喜欢这个女儿。
sentences.traditional: 周爸爸和周媽媽都很喜歡這個女兒。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu bà ba hé zhōu mā ma dōu hěn xǐ huan zhè ge nǚ ér
sentences.english: Both Father Zhou and Mother Zhou liked their daughter very much.

sentences.simplified: 女儿要什么，他们就给什么。
sentences.traditional: 女兒要什麼，他們就給什麼。
sentences.pinyin: nǚ ér yào shén me tā men jiù gěi shén me
sentences.english: They gave their daughter whatever she wanted.

sentences.simplified: 小英看哥哥读书，她也想读书。
sentences.traditional: 小英看哥哥讀書，她也想讀書。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng kàn gē ge dú shū tā yě xiǎng dú shū
sentences.english: Xiao Ying saw the older brother study, and she also wanted to study.

sentences.simplified: 但是那个时候，女孩子要在家里学习做衣服、做饭，不能上学。
sentences.traditional: 但是那個時候，女孩子要在家裡學習做衣服、做飯，不能上學。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì nà ge shí hou nǚ hái zi yào zài jiā lǐ xué xí zuò yī fu zuò fàn bù néng shàng xué
sentences.english: But at that time, girls had to learn to make clothes and cook at home and couldn’t go to school.

sentences.simplified: 在学校里上学的都是男孩子，没有女孩子。
sentences.traditional: 在學校裡上學的都是男孩子，沒有女孩子。
sentences.pinyin: zài xué xiào lǐ shàng xué de dōu shì nán hái zi méi yǒu nǚ hái zi
sentences.english: Those who studied at school were all boys, there were no girls.

sentences.simplified: 周小英想去上学，但是她的爸爸妈妈不给她去上学。
sentences.traditional: 周小英想去上學，但是她的爸爸媽媽不給她去上學。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu xiǎo yīng xiǎng qù shàng xué dàn shì tā de bà ba mā ma bù gěi tā qù shàng xué
sentences.english: Zhou Xiao Ying wanted to go to school, but her father and mother didn’t let her go to school.

sentences.simplified: 小英想：我要怎么办？
sentences.traditional: 小英想：我要怎麼辦？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng xiǎng wǒ yào zěn me bàn
sentences.english: Xiao Ying thought: What should I do?

sentences.simplified: 她想了很长时间，想到了一个好办法。
sentences.traditional: 她想了很長時間，想到了一個好辦法。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng le hěn cháng shí jiān xiǎng dào le yí ge hǎo bàn fǎ
sentences.english: She thought for a very long time and figured out a good way.

sentences.simplified: 一天，周小英的下人小七跑来告诉周爸爸周妈妈：
sentences.traditional: 一天，周小英的下人小七跑來告訴周爸爸周媽媽：
sentences.pinyin: yì tiān zhōu xiǎo yīng de xià rén xiǎo qī pǎo lái gào su zhōu bà ba zhōu mā ma
sentences.english: One day, Zhou Xiao Ying’s servant Xiao Qi ran to tell Father Zhou and Mother Zhou:

sentences.simplified: “小英小姐生病了！”
sentences.traditional: “小英小姐生病了！”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng xiǎo jiě shēng bìng le
sentences.english: “Miss Xiao Ying has fallen ill!”

sentences.simplified: 周爸爸周妈妈来到小英的房间，看到小英睡在床上，看起来很累。
sentences.traditional: 周爸爸周媽媽來到小英的房間，看到小英睡在床上，看起來很累。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu bà ba zhōu mā ma lái dào xiǎo yīng de fáng jiān kàn dào xiǎo yīng shuì zài chuáng shang kàn qǐ lái hěn lèi
sentences.english: Father Zhou and Mother Zhou came to Xiao Ying’s room, and saw Xiao Ying sleeping in the bed, seemingly very tired.

sentences.simplified: 他们找了医生来家里给小英看病，
sentences.traditional: 他們找了醫生來家裡給小英看病，
sentences.pinyin: tā men zhǎo le yī shēng lái jiā lǐ gěi xiǎo yīng kàn bìng
sentences.english: They looked for a doctor to come to their house and see Xiao Ying, ..

sentences.simplified: 但是医生看来看去，没有看出小英得的是什么病。
sentences.traditional: 但是醫生看來看去，沒有看出小英得的是什麼病。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì yī shēng kàn lái kàn qù méi yǒu kàn chū xiǎo yīng dé de shì shén me bìng
sentences.english: .. but the doctor looked here and there, and couldn’t make out what illness Xiao Ying had.

sentences.simplified: 他们找了很多个医生，但是都没有医生知道小英得的是什么病。
sentences.traditional: 他們找了很多個醫生，但是都沒有醫生知道小英得的是什麼病。
sentences.pinyin: tā men zhǎo le hěn duō ge yī shēng dàn shì dōu méi yǒu yī shēng zhī dào xiǎo yīng dé de shì shén me bìng
sentences.english: They looked for a lot of doctors, but there was no doctor at all that knew what illness Xiao Ying had.

sentences.simplified: 周爸爸和周妈妈就这么一个女儿，他们很爱这个女儿。
sentences.traditional: 周爸爸和周媽媽就這麼一個女兒，他們很愛這個女兒。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu bà ba hé zhōu mā ma jiù zhè me yí ge nǚ ér tā men hěn ài zhè ge nǚ ér
sentences.english: Father Zhou and Mother Zhou had just one daughter, and they really loved this daughter.

sentences.simplified: 他们想：要是有哪个医生能让我们的女儿好起来，
sentences.traditional: 他們想：要是有哪個醫生能讓我們的女兒好起來，
sentences.pinyin: tā men xiǎng yào shi yǒu nǎ ge yī shēng néng ràng wǒ men de nǚ ér hǎo qǐ lái
sentences.english: They thought: If there is such a doctor that is able to make our daughter well, ..

sentences.simplified: 医生说什么，我们就做什么。
sentences.traditional: 醫生說什麼，我們就做什麼。
sentences.pinyin: yī shēng shuō shén me wǒ men jiù zuò shén me
sentences.english: .. we will do whatever that doctor says.

sentences.simplified: 几天后，一个医生来到小英家。
sentences.traditional: 幾天後，一個醫生來到小英家。
sentences.pinyin: jǐ tiān hòu yí ge yī shēng lái dào xiǎo yīng jiā
sentences.english: A few days later, a doctor came to Xiao Ying’s home.

sentences.simplified: 他不是很高，但是穿着很大的衣服，看起来很好笑。
sentences.traditional: 他不是很高，但是穿著很大的衣服，看起來很好笑。
sentences.pinyin: tā bú shì hěn gāo dàn shì chuān zhe hěn dà de yī fu kàn qǐ lái hěn hǎo xiào
sentences.english: He wasn’t very tall, but wore very large clothes, and looked very ridiculous.

sentences.simplified: 周爸爸和周妈妈看着这个医生，他们觉得这个医生好像在哪里见过。
sentences.traditional: 周爸爸和周媽媽看著這個醫生，他們覺得這個醫生好像在哪裏見過。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu bà ba hé zhōu mā ma kàn zhe zhè ge yī shēng tā men jué de zhè ge yī shēng hǎo xiàng zài nǎ lǐ jiàn guò
sentences.english: Father Zhou and Mother Zhou watched this doctor and felt like they’d seen this doctor somewhere before.

sentences.simplified: 这个医生来到小英房间，给小英看病。
sentences.traditional: 這個醫生來到小英房間，給小英看病。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge yī shēng lái dào xiǎo yīng fáng jiān gěi xiǎo yīng kàn bìng
sentences.english: This doctor came to Xiao Ying's room, to examine Xiao Ying.

sentences.simplified: 他看了一会儿后，走出房间，对周爸爸周妈妈说：
sentences.traditional: 他看了一會兒後，走出房間，對周爸爸周媽媽說：
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn le yí huì'r hòu zǒu chū fáng jiān duì zhōu bà ba zhōu mā ma shuō
sentences.english: After he had checked her for a while, he came out of the room, and said to Father Zhou and Mother Zhou:

sentences.simplified: “我知道你们的女儿得的是什么病。”
sentences.traditional: “我知道你們的女兒得的是什麼病。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào nǐ men de nǚ ér dé de shì shén me bìng
sentences.english: “I know what illness your daughter has.”

sentences.simplified: 周爸爸和周妈妈很高兴，问：
sentences.traditional: 周爸爸和周媽媽很高興，問：
sentences.pinyin: zhōu bà ba hé zhōu mā ma hěn gāo xìng wèn
sentences.english: Father Zhou and Mother Zhou were very happy, and asked:

sentences.simplified: “我们的女儿得的是什么病？你快说。”
sentences.traditional: “我們的女兒得的是什麼病？你快說。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men de nǚ ér dé de shì shén me bìng nǐ kuài shuō
sentences.english: “What illness does our daughter have? You tell us quickly.”

sentences.simplified: （未完待续）
sentences.traditional: （未完待續）

sentences.english: (To be continued)

raw.synopsis: This is our elementary level adaptation of the classic Chinese legend “Butterfly Lovers”.
sentence_translations: He? She? (Part 1)
1,600 years ago, Hangzhou.
Zhou Xiao Ying wanted to go to school, but she couldn’t go to school.
Zhou Xiao Ying’s family had a lot of houses and a lot of land. Her family was the wealthiest family in Hangzhou.
The Zhou family was Father Zhou, Mother Zhou, Zhou Yiyi and Zhou Xiao Ying.
Zhou Yiyi was the older brother, 23 years old, and studied at the School of a Hundred Books.
The School of a Hundred Books was the biggest and best school there.
Zhou Xiao Ying was the younger sister, 16 years old.
Both Father Zhou and Mother Zhou liked their daughter very much.
They gave their daughter whatever she wanted.
Xiao Ying saw the older brother study, and she also wanted to study.
But at that time, girls had to learn to make clothes and cook at home and couldn’t go to school.
Those who studied at school were all boys, there were no girls.
Zhou Xiao Ying wanted to go to school, but her father and mother didn’t let her go to school.
Xiao Ying thought: What should I do?
She thought for a very long time and figured out a good way.
One day, Zhou Xiao Ying’s servant Xiao Qi ran to tell Father Zhou and Mother Zhou:
“Miss Xiao Ying has fallen ill!”
Father Zhou and Mother Zhou came to Xiao Ying’s room, and saw Xiao Ying sleeping in the bed, seemingly very tired.
They looked for a doctor to come to their house and see Xiao Ying, ..
.. but the doctor looked here and there, and couldn’t make out what illness Xiao Ying had.
They looked for a lot of doctors, but there was no doctor at all that knew what illness Xiao Ying had.
Father Zhou and Mother Zhou had just one daughter, and they really loved this daughter.
They thought: If there is such a doctor that is able to make our daughter well, ..
.. we will do whatever that doctor says.
A few days later, a doctor came to Xiao Ying’s home.
He wasn’t very tall, but wore very large clothes, and looked very ridiculous.
Father Zhou and Mother Zhou watched this doctor and felt like they’d seen this doctor somewhere before.
This doctor came to Xiao Ying's room, to examine Xiao Ying.
After he had checked her for a while, he came out of the room, and said to Father Zhou and Mother Zhou:
“I know what illness your daughter has.”
Father Zhou and Mother Zhou were very happy, and asked:
“What illness does our daughter have? You tell us quickly.”
(To be continued)
